0.original: Eshana needs you to borrow a griffin's wings.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Please note that the difficulty of this quest has been synced to your current level. Furthermore, you may not proceed with a class or job that is different from when you accepted this quest.

25.original: Use the griffin's Buffet ability on frenzied swarms.

48.original: Ah, jussst the ssstrider I wanted to sssee. We have sssoldiers out on a joint training exercise, and they've sssent a requessst for aid.

49.original: As matters ssstand, you'll be needing a griffin to render the necessary assistance. Giff will explain the sssituation.

50.original: Here to lend a hand, are you, <hex:02080EE905FF056C617373FF046C616403>? I don't know what Eshana's told you, but it seems our fighters are being swarmed by tiny flying vilekin. Actual <hex:021A020203>swarms<hex:021A020103> of them.

51.original: I don't know what our folk did to annoy them, but once those pests get riled up, there's no shooing them away.

52.original: My plan is for you to fly a griffin over to Virdjala, and have it disperse those biting buggers with a good buffet from its wings.

53.original: Once you're done, you can hop off wherever you please─the griffin's trained to return to me after the rider dismounts. Might be easiest if you report directly to Eshana, of course.

54.original: Hells-spawned fiends! There's a dozen more for every one I swat!

55.original: A swarm of vilekin is attacking this soldier. Speak with Giff in Castellum Velodyna and borrow a griffin for its Buffet ability.

56.original: I've ssslapped and ssswiped a hundred times but they won't leave him be!

57.original: Oof! Why did you─ Oh, they're gone! Thank Rhalgr!

58.original: ...And thank <hex:021A020203>you<hex:021A020103>. If you hadn't come, my comrade here would have been bitten and stung to death.

59.original: Aye, not exactly the kind of training I signed up for. We'd best find a new place to spar.

60.original: Godsdamn these winged demons! Get away from me!

62.original: Phew... Thank you so much. I thought those little bastards would eat me alive...

63.original: Those pesssts ignored me and flew ssstraight at him. Curious. We'll head back for now, and have this ssstrider's wounds ssseen to.

64.original: Lost your griffin, did you? Here, try to stay in the saddle this time.

66.original: That is a relief. Being blasssted by a griffin's wings was likely unpleasant, but better that than sssuffer a ssslow death from a ssswarm.

68.original: I am told by my sssisters that it was only those of certain ssstock who were targeted by the vilekin─they've a tassste for Highlander blood, it would ssseem. It is a wonder that you did not fall victim to the sssame fate.

69.original: I am told by my sssisters that it was only those of certain ssstock who were targeted by the vilekin─they've a tassste for Highlander blood, it would ssseem.

70.original: Ssspeaking of which, Giff is apparently terrified of those insssects. He mussst have been glad indeed that you arrived to perform the ressscue in his ssstead...

71.original: You've blown away those little buggers then, have you? Head over to Eshana and tell her the good news.
